violations.title: Every tenant must declare a tenant-level rate limit within bounds
violations.why: A per-route rate limit alone caps each route individually, but a tenant with many routes can still exhaust shared gateway capacity in aggregate; a tenant-level cap is the backstop for that.
violations.fix: Add a top-level rate_limit.rps and rate_limit.burst for the tenant (e.g. rps: 50, burst: 50).

violations.title: Tenants handling PII should declare which fields to redact
violations.why: A tenant whose data_classification names personal data but leaves pii_fields empty gets no redaction in access logs by name, only the gateway's fixed baseline.
violations.fix: Add pii_fields listing the request fields (e.g. query parameters) that carry personal data for this tenant.

violations.title: No API keys, tokens or passwords inlined in plaintext
violations.why: A secret committed to a config repo is permanently compromised, it lives in git history even after deletion.
violations.fix: Remove the plaintext value; store a hash (api_key_hashed) or reference a secret manager entry instead.

violations.title: CORS must not combine a wildcard origin with credentials
violations.why: A wildcard origin plus allow_credentials:true lets any website replay a user's cookies/tokens against this tenant's API.
violations.fix: List explicit allowed origins, or set allow_credentials: false.

violations.title: Routes must not expose /admin, /internal or /debug paths
violations.why: These path segments are a strong signal of an operational surface that should never be reachable from the public gateway.
violations.fix: Remove the route, or move the admin/internal surface behind a separate, non-tenant-facing deployment.
